toy_repo

Nine boxes: four run in-house, three rented, two called from the client.

Tech stack

The gateway label says nginx; the image says Envoy.

  • 1 · Gateway

    Envoy 1.29, not nginx, despite the nginx.conf in the repo root.

    image: envoyproxy/envoy:v1.29
  • 2 · Auth

    Auth0, reached through @auth0/nextjs-auth0 at apps/web/lib/auth.ts:8.
